description: Epistesys Beta 6.9: an explicitly unfinished, source-only TLCX development snapshot. Includes typed context, multi-logic, TranslationLoss/S_Creative, binary/resource, Coding and host-boundary work; whole-system audit, release gates, research evaluation and real-host closure are not complete.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect bounded Epistesys control and DGCL source paths.
interface.longDescription: An intermediate source snapshot preserving the Alpha.3 baseline and ongoing TLCX implementation. Adds source for typed context reconstruction, finite logic solvers, four-record TranslationLoss, original F1/F2 creativity arithmetic, bounded binary state and resource ownership, and Coding/Media/host integration. Some producer and consumer paths remain unfinished or unregistered. This checkpoint is not release-ready, an audited installable package, a completed Beta-7.0 implementation, or evidence of semantic, performance, safety or real-host improvement.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this request through the Epistesys Beta 6.9 development source without treating pending gates as success.
Review the snapshot's explicit implementation, evidence and authority boundaries without changing files.
